title: observability: add token-level KV cache cost/latency breakdowns + dashboards and alert tuning
author: Maya Patel
description: Adds token-level KV cache metrics (hits, misses, evictions) and per-token cost/latency breakdowns exposed via Prometheus metrics and tracing spans; implements new Grafana dashboards and refines alerting thresholds to reduce noise for large-batch workloads. Motivation: customers and SREs requested finer-grained accounting of KV cache behavior and per-token unit economics after several incidents where cache thrashing caused latency spikes and cost overruns. This PR instruments the serving runtime to emit: 1) kv_cache_tokens_total{result="hit|miss|evict",model,zone,tenant} 2) kv_cache_latency_seconds_bucket{model,zone,tenant} for token-on-cache latency distribution 3) token_cost_cents_total{model,route,tenant} computed from per-token execution time + kernel-cost multipliers. It also propagates token metadata into tracing spans (kv.cache.* attributes) and exposes a small helper in observability to aggregate token-level metrics to per-route dashboards. The dashboards added: "KV Cache Token Metrics (per-model)", "Token Cost & Latency Breakdown (per-route)", and a condensed "Token Economy Overview" for on-call. Alert tuning: added two new alerts (kv_cache_miss_rate_high and token_cost_spike) with graded severities and longer evaluation windows to avoid flapping during autoscaling; adjusted existing p95/p99 latency alerts to ignore cold-start noise and prioritize cache-miss correlated spikes. Implementation notes: changes touch the runtime metric emitter (services/serving/runtime/metrics/kv_metrics.go), tracing propagation (services/serving/runtime/tracing/kv_span_propagation.go), dashboard jsonnet and grafana provisioning (observability/dashboards/kv_token_dashboards.jsonnet), alert rules (observability/alerts/kv_token_alerts.yaml), and small SDK helpers for metric labels (libs/observability/labels.go). Included unit tests for metric formats and an integration canary that runs against perf-canary dataset. Backwards compatibility: metric names are additive and existing dashboards remain unchanged. See linked Linear tickets for acceptance criteria.
